sourceRefs.locator: Vita Karoli Magni, ch. 26 (columns and marble), 28 (imperial title and reported reluctance), 30–31 (death, choice of burial place and burial).
Brief synthesis and Description: the octagon, gallery and dome, spolia from Rome and Ravenna and burial in 814. World Heritage property 3, location coordinates.

labels.en: A grave in the palace chapel

note.de: Karl starb 814 in Aachen und wurde dort in seiner Kirche bestattet. Das Oktogon ist bis heute Teil des Doms.
note.en: Charles died at Aachen in 814 and was buried in his church there. Its octagon forms part of the present cathedral.
